title: Uprooter of Mountains
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Meir and Resh Lakish were called by this honored title. Sanhedrin 24a says, “One who sees Rabbi Meir in the study hall sees him as though uprooting mountains upon mountains,” and “One who sees Resh Lakish in the study hall sees him as though uprooting mountains and grinding them against one another.” Rabbah, too, was called an uprooter of mountains at the end of Horayot.
